name: Template: Infrastructure & DevOps
description: Track infrastructure incidents, changes, and improvements. Each swimlane is a system; each card is a work item.

swimlanes.name: API Gateway
swimlanes.notes: Kong gateway in front of all public endpoints. SLO: 99.9% uptime, p95 < 200ms.

swimlanes.name: PostgreSQL Cluster
swimlanes.notes: Primary + 2 replicas. RDS PostgreSQL 16. Nightly backups to S3. Point-in-time recovery enabled.

swimlanes.name: CI/CD Pipeline
swimlanes.notes: GitLab CI on Kubernetes runners. Kaniko for image builds. p95 pipeline: 8 min.

swimlanes.name: Object Storage (S3)
swimlanes.notes: AWS S3: attachments, backups, analytics exports. Versioning enabled. Cross-region replication to eu-west-1.

swimlanes.name: Kubernetes Cluster
swimlanes.notes: EKS 1.29. 3 node groups. HPA on API and worker deployments. Node count: 12.

During last month's DB failover, the API gateway continued routing traffic, causing request queuing and timeout cascades.

Add a circuit breaker that opens after 3 consecutive DB timeouts.
